script.title: My AI Closed 3 Deals While I Slept
script.hook: While you slept last night, my AI agent closed three deals and banked $8,400. Here's how.

Empire OS drops AI agents into your business that find leads, qualify them, handle objections, and close — on autopilot. 24/7. No sleep required.

Your competitors are already deploying AI. Every single day you wait, they close another deal that should be yours.
